records.name: Rivers
records.summary: Rivers state: Nigerian federal law criminalises same-sex conduct (SSMPA 2014); southern-state Criminal Code 14 years; riverside Port Harcourt LGBT community visible but policed.

records.name: Kwara
records.summary: Kwara state: federal SSMPA 2014; state-level Sharia penal law in Ilorin (Kwara is a betwixt state).

records.name: West Nusa Tenggara
records.summary: NTB province: Indonesian Penal Code (new 2023 code); 2015 NTB bylaw against LGBT conduct (draft/partial); Lombok culture.

records.name: Yucatan
records.summary: Yucatan: Mexican federal framework (marriage, gender identity by decree 0732/2026); Yucatan state gender-identity law (2021) + conversion-therapy ban.
